topography.project_purpose: Derivatives. Structurally: 84 project-authored contract(s) across 4 chain(s); 6 ERC20 tokens, 2 ERC721 NFTs; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 18 common project-authored base contract(s) (dsmath, dsauth, dsauthevents). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
